scenes.title: What Does a Holiday Let in St James Earn?
scenes.vo: What does a holiday let in St James actually earn? Here's what the data says.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate across 500 St James holiday lets
scenes.vo: The median nightly rate across five hundred holiday lets in St James is ninety-two pounds. That's about a hundred and twenty-one US dollars.
At sixty percent occupancy, that's roughly one thousand six hundred and seventy-five pounds a month, before costs.
The APG Deal Analyser pulls these numbers live, by parish, property type and bedrooms.
But cleaning, platform fees and management all come off that figure.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in bio.
